instruction: How many unique songs are there across my Spotify song library, albums library and all playlists?
notes: Read-only question task: no database changes are allowed, so the goal only demands the three library lookups be collected into the single aggregate record object `unique-song-count` and the task be completed with that count as the answer. The count object is a task record (not an API argument) passed to each lookup action so the three show_*_library actions can contribute to the same aggregate; at runtime each library API must be paginated (page_index) and the answer is the size of the union of song ids. The login username is the supervisor's email from show_profile; the password comes from show_account_passwords. The three lookups may occur in any order after login; complete_task is forced last via (not (task-completed)) on every other action.
